facts.text: Snow left State Lakes (10,400 ft) 30 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 31 (2024), May 30 (2025); 2023: readings jump by more than snow can

facts.text: At State Lakes (10,400 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 4.7 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: 4.7 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 25.7 in (2024), 23.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 13 and May 12, carried from the melt-out date at State Lakes (10,400 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 1,096 ft above the pass; points to March 13 to May 12
